title: Verdant WSG evidence snapshot

wsg_edition.label: W3C Web Sustainability Guidelines TR snapshot reviewed on 2026-09-22

scope: Selected implementation evidence for the homepage and shared static assets in this repository. This record is not a live deployment audit, does not claim full WSG conformance, and links to related records that own broader hosting, transfer-size, and reduced-data validation.

related_records.label: Issue #19 — measured and estimated byte reporting
Issue #26 — broader hosting and governance evidence

entries.scope: Repository build output and measurement wiring, not final deployed transfer totals or future script-delivery changes.
entries.summary: The repo build generates the homepage HTML, a shared stylesheet, and local compressed-size estimates. Final byte reporting and script-delivery conclusions are tracked in linked records rather than fixed here.

entries.scope: Generated page structure and metadata for the homepage and component gallery.
entries.summary: Generated pages include landmarks, a skip link, a single h1 per page, a canonical URL, and JSON-LD website metadata.

entries.scope: Defaults shown in the generated pages and PandaCSS output.
entries.summary: Color-scheme and reduced-motion defaults are implemented in the generated UI. Reduced-data behavior is currently limited and is described in linked records rather than treated as broad conformance evidence here.

entries.scope: Repository-managed static assets and configuration files, not human-reviewed governance or hosting assurances.
entries.summary: The repo includes CSP, HSTS, Permissions-Policy, nosniff, cache rules, robots.txt, and a sitemap. Broader hosting and governance evidence remains linked work, and deployed responses still depend on the platform applying these files as configured.

entries.scope: Generated form, focus, theme, and motion examples in the component gallery.
entries.summary: The component gallery demonstrates labelled fields with autocomplete and inputmode, a visible focus style, no autoplay media, and system-font defaults.

entries.scope: Live deployment behavior outside the repository build output.
entries.summary: Green hosting provenance, CDN compression behavior, and final live-response headers need external verification. The repo can prepare assets and configuration, but it cannot prove deployed infrastructure outcomes on its own.
